project_type: TypeScript monorepo - pnpm workspace with packages/ and apps/ structure
build_system: pnpm 9.15.4 workspace (corepack via nvm). Build order matters: domain -> trust-protocol -> workflow -> evidence/payment-sdk/shopify-connector -> merchant-application -> apps. Must use: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
test_framework: Vitest 3.0.7, fast-check 4.0.0 for property tests. Each package has its own vitest run script.
build_command: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm build
test_command: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm --filter @counter/razorpay-adapter --filter @counter/payment-sdk --filter @counter/evidence --filter @counter/shopify-connector --filter @counter/merchant-application --filter @counter/merchant-policy --filter @counter/control-plane-api --filter @counter/reference-buyer --filter @counter/merchant-console test
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm build (all packages compile). 2. pnpm test on relevant packages. 3. pnpm typecheck on modified packages.
setup_instructions: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm install && pnpm build
environment_constraints: Node via nvm at /opt/toolchains/.nvm (v22.23.2). No docker daemon. Network likely COMMON_DEPENDENCIES. packages/contracts and packages/connector-sdk have pre-existing test failures (fast-check not resolved) - do NOT try to fix these.
contribution_requirements: Follow PILOT.md strictly: test-only modes, no live money, INR only, environment enforcement, signed CTP envelopes. PaymentProvider port pattern. Immutable frozen objects. Branded types from @counter/domain. All evidence must be CTP-signed.
key_patterns: 1. Port interfaces in types.ts, implementations in separate files. 2. Branded types via Brand<T,Name> from @counter/domain. 3. Frozen immutable return objects (Object.freeze). 4. CanonicalError from @counter/domain for errors. 5. CTP envelope signing for evidence. 6. Each package exports from index.ts. 7. Tests colocated as *.test.ts. 8. Vitest with describe/it/expect. 9. Package references via workspace:0.1.0.
directory_structure: packages/: domain, trust-protocol, workflow, data, config, privacy, testkit, observability, authorization, policy, contracts, connector-sdk, http-api-kit, evidence, payment-sdk, shopify-connector, razorpay-adapter, commerce-graph, merchant-application, merchant-policy, merchant-contracts, reference-connector. apps/: agent-runtime, control-plane-api, merchant-console, operations-console, reference-buyer, reference-services, wallet-console, worker, local-mcp.
